office: the Department of Civil and National Registration

routes.label: at a regional or district civil registration office: 14 working days

note: The Government of Botswana's service page: citizens from 16 register for the Omang, issued in fourteen working days; registered within 30 days of turning 16 (or of acquiring citizenship) it is free, later registration draws a fine of up to BWP 500 (not modelled); a renewal, change of surname or damaged card costs BWP 5 and a lost or stolen one BWP 110 (not modelled). The embassy in Washington gives its term: ten years.

sources.title: Government of Botswana, National Identity Card Application
sources.said: All citizens of Botswana who are 16 years and above are eligible for this service. ... How long will this service take? Fourteen(14) working days.

sources.title: Government of Botswana, civil registration services (listing, National Identity Card Application)
sources.said: Where Identity Card is registered within the prescribed time (30 days after attaining 16 years of age or acquiring citizenship), an Identity card is issued for free. Any registration done after that period attracts a fine not exceeding BWP500.00 A fee of BWP5.00 is payable for renewals, change of surname, and damaged Identity. A fee of BWP110.00 is payable for lost and stolen Identity Card.

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Botswana, Washington, National Identity Card (Omang)
sources.said: This card is also commonly known as Omang and is valid for 10 years, after which it must be renewed.
